text:
alex: Postmortem follow-up from yesterday's regional failover test. Summarizing remediation items and owners — please ack and add ETAs. Observed patterns: routing flaps under surge, delayed snapshot availability, and restore steps not fully exercised.

alex: Action items (short):
- multi-region routing policy + automated fallback -> owner: sachin, ETA requested
- backups verification + restore runbook updates -> owner: maria, ETA requested
- restore dry-run (game-day) in prod-like env -> owner: jess, schedule requested
- add recurring mini game-days for cold-cache warming -> owner: priya, proposal requested

sachin: Ack. I'll take routing policy changes and the fallback automation. Plan: adjust route priorities, add active health-probe thresholds, and run a canary failover in staging. ETA 2026-04-10. :white_check_mark:

maria: I will own backups + runbook updates. I'll validate incremental snapshot consistency, add checksum verification, and document S3 lifecycle expectations. ETA 2026-03-30. I'll post the runbook link when done.

jess: I can run the restore dry-run in a prod-like stack. Suggest scheduling the game-day on 2026-04-07 so we have time to incorporate fixes. Need list of slices to restore and a point contact for infra changes.

priya: Recommend we turn this into a monthly mini-game-day (smoke restores + routing failover) after the first round. Also add a warmup step for KV caches in the runbook so caches don't cause apparent failures.

dan: Added a tracker spreadsheet (internal access only) and created subtasks for each action. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/FAKE-TRACKER (request access if you can't open).

alex: Notes for owners: please create JIRA tickets with label "dr-followup" and include the ETA. I'll collect updates for a one-pager for leadership by 2026-04-12.

sachin: Quick technical note — for automated fallback we need route-recap script to have S3 read perms for route snapshots; will file a small infra PR. Also test plan:
```yaml
- staging canary failover (low-traffic)
- monitor tail-latency and error-rate for 30m
- rollback if >2% errors or latency spike >200ms
```

maria: Example restore command to include in runbook:
```bash
./restore-db.sh --snapshot s3://redwood-backups/2026-03-20 --region us-east1 --verify-checksums
```
Will include verification steps and time estimates.

jess: +1. I'll schedule the dry-run in staging next Wed and send invites to SRE + Product infra owners. @drillbot can you remind #incidents one day before? :calendar:

drillbot: Reminder scheduled -> Channel: #incidents. Event: Game-day prep reminder on 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC. :bell:

alex: Owners: please update this thread with progress or blockers. If anyone needs extra hands for the dry-run reach out here.

priya: I'll draft the monthly-game-day checklist (short runbook) and drop it in this thread by 2026-03-28.

maria: Runbook draft uploaded: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dr-restore (internal link placeholder). Added checksum step and an explicit restore verification checklist.

dan: Tracker updated: each ticket now has an owner and due date. Notified SRE rotation for the game-day.

jess: Invite sent to >20 folks, added calendar notes for run duration and rollback windows.

alex: Thanks all. If nothing else, we'll reconvene after the staging dry-run for a final signoff before production game-day. :thumbsup:
